title: Jump Game
definition: Given an array of maximum jump lengths, determine if you can reach the last index. The greedy approach tracks the `farthest` index reachable. If at any point `i > farthest`, you are stuck.
simpleExplanation: At every stepping stone, look to see how far you could possibly jump. If you reach a stone where your maximum jump distance is 0, you lose.
